## README.md
# Trazo Field Boundary Annotations (fiboa)

Field boundary annotations from the [Trazo project](https://wri.github.io/trazo/landing/) (WRI & Arizona State University), converted to [fiboa](https://fiboa.org) GeoParquet.

Trazo extends the [Fields of The World (FTW)](https://fieldsofthe.world/) baseline with **60,386 manually annotated field boundary polygons across 17 South American ecoregions** — the Chaco, Chiquitania, Araucaria, Amazon, Cerrado, Caatinga, Pampas and others — created to adapt field boundary segmentation models to South American agricultural landscapes.

## Relationship to FTW (no duplication)

This dataset contains **only the new Trazo annotations**. The upstream Trazo repository intentionally excludes FTW data ("intended to be used in conjunction with the FTW benchmark dataset"), and we verified this spatially: FTW's only South American subset (LEM, West Bahia, Brazil — 1,854 fields) has **zero polygon intersections** with this dataset. You can safely combine this dataset with the FTW benchmark without deduplication.

## Contents

- `wri_trazo.parquet` — fiboa GeoParquet (fiboa 0.3.0, GeoParquet 1.1.0), 60,386 features, EPSG:4326
- `stac/collection.json` — STAC Collection metadata

## Columns

| Property                 | Type      | Description                                                        |
|--------------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `id`                     | string    | Unique identifier (`trazo_NNNNNN`)                                 |
| `geometry`               | Polygon   | Field boundary (EPSG:4326)                                         |
| `collection`             | string    | `wri_trazo`                                                        |
| `metrics:area`           | float     | Field area in square meters (computed in EPSG:6933 equal-area)     |
| `metrics:perimeter`      | float     | Field perimeter in meters (computed in EPSG:6933 equal-area)       |
| `determination:datetime` | timestamp | Annotation year (Jan 1 of the labeled year, 2020–2024)             |
| `determination:method`   | string    | `manual` — annotated by subject-matter experts                     |
| `region`                 | string    | Source ecoregion / sampling folder (25 values, e.g. `chaco`, `maparaguay`, `testsoy`) |
| `split`                  | string    | `train` (52,484) or `test` (7,902); `test` = randomly sampled test folders |

Regions prefixed `test` (`testchiquitania`, `testmatogrosso`, `testsoy`) were truly randomly sampled and are the statistically rigorous choice for model evaluation. Other regions were selected for poor baseline model performance, active-learning query strategies (`matogrosso_brazil_*`), or partner data availability (`maparaguay` — Mundo Agropecuario), and are best used for training/validation.

## Lineage

- Source: [source.coop/wri-data-lab/trazoannotations](https://source.coop/wri-data-lab/trazoannotations) (per-ecoregion GeoPackages)
- Normalization: reprojected to EPSG:4326, geometries made valid, multipart polygons exploded, Z dimension dropped; per-feature `year` filled from the source filename where the column was absent (test folders)
- Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) 0.21.0 using the `wri_trazo` converter
